headline: Marymount (Va.) leads the AEC in wins and goals
dek: Marymount (Va.) finished with thirteen wins, one draw, and eight losses, scoring 51 goals while conceding 22 to stand as the sole AEC program above even overall. It swept conference play and won more matches than Centenary (N.J.), Gwynedd Mercy, and Pratt Institute combined.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Scoring drops sharply behind the leader: Marymount (Va.) produced 51 goals, more than Immaculata and Pratt Institute combined, leaving the rest of the conference clustered in a much lower tier.

wire.line: AEC programs won twelve non-conference matches, drew six, and lost 42, scoring 64 goals while conceding 160.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Marymount (Va.) midfielder Erick Shoetter-Rojas led all AEC scorers with fourteen goals and four assists from 57 shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Immaculata goalkeeper Luca Greppellini led the AEC with 99 saves against 23 goals allowed, posting a 0.811 save percentage.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Gwynedd Mercy conceded 57 goals while scoring 21, allowing more goals than any other program in the AEC.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Three matches remain past their scheduled dates with no published result: Saint Elizabeth away at William Paterson and Cairn, and Centenary (N.J.) away at Ramapo.

last_match.line: Marymount (Va.) entered off consecutive shutout wins over AEC rivals before closing its season on the road.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
